copy.step0_intro_2: Scops suggested that we animal-talents take a pack of critter medicines to the mainland each time the Fairies changed the seasons.
copy.step0_intro_3: Scops reminded us that things as big as the change of seasons can make some animals sick. But we can help 'em!
copy.step0_intro_4: That's how the Heal Talent Skill got started. So how about it? Are you ready to help make a Critter Health Pack an' learn Heal?
